Name: Check host readiness and capabilities
Main_Flow: Read reviewed local profile; probe OS, kernel, cgroup v2, PSI and optional eBPF; report each capability; default to OBSERVE_ONLY.
Alternatives_and_Failures: Unsupported features disabled; invalid config or failed health remains fail-closed.

Name: Collect CPU, RAM, I/O and PSI observations
Main_Flow: Read supported host/process interfaces; preserve source, unit, scope, interval, UTC and monotonic time; eBPF only when approved.
Alternatives_and_Failures: Represent missing, denied, stale and unsupported inputs explicitly.
Related_Use_Case_Relationships: Includes UC-03: every collected sample is sent through quality and process-identity validation.

Name: Validate sample quality and process identity
Main_Flow: Validate shape, units, age, source health, counters, PID and start time; invalidate deltas on reset or identity change.
Alternatives_and_Failures: Invalid or stale input cannot authorize a write.

Name: Persist bounded telemetry
Main_Flow: Append to local SQLite with retention, database and WAL limits; expose read-only projections.
Alternatives_and_Failures: Record storage errors; never fabricate zero for unavailable data.
Related_Use_Case_Relationships: Extends UC-03 when the sample is accepted: only valid telemetry is appended to the bounded store.

Name: Generate provenance-bound prediction
Main_Flow: Exchange generic prediction with exact source-window and quality context; keep inference unprivileged.
Alternatives_and_Failures: Reject late/invalid outputs; inference has no OS write or direct actuator path.

Name: Decide per-process outcome
Main_Flow: Emit LEAVE or reasoned proposal/denial for each eligible process and window.

Name: Apply policy admission gates
Main_Flow: Check mode, target, allowlist, freshness, bounds, cooldown, authorization and separate resource capability.
Alternatives_and_Failures: OBSERVE_ONLY, unsupported or forbidden actions become audited recommendations/denials.
Related_Use_Case_Relationships: Extends UC-06 when the outcome contains a proposal: only proposed actions proceed to policy admission.

Name: Authenticate and revalidate actuator request
Main_Flow: Use Unix socket and SO_PEERCRED; immediately recheck mode, bounds, cgroup/process identity, ownership and device.
Alternatives_and_Failures: Reject peer/target mismatch with no write.
Related_Use_Case_Relationships: Extends UC-07 when policy admits a proposal. UC-09, UC-10, and UC-11 each include UC-08 before resource-specific writes.

Name: Apply guarded CPU control
Main_Flow: Capture prior cpu.weight, apply bounded value to approved cgroup, read back and audit.
Alternatives_and_Failures: Restore only if current identity and AIOS ownership still verify.
Related_Use_Case_Relationships: Includes UC-08: CPU writes require authenticated peer identity and immediate target/policy revalidation.

Name: Apply guarded RAM control
Main_Flow: Capture prior memory.high, apply bounded value, read back and audit.
Alternatives_and_Failures: Never write memory.max or terminate a process; guarded restore only.
Related_Use_Case_Relationships: Includes UC-08: RAM writes require authenticated peer identity and immediate target/policy revalidation.

Name: Apply guarded device-specific I/O control
Main_Flow: Check supported controller/device; capture prior io.weight/io.max for that device; apply and read back same control.
Alternatives_and_Failures: Unsupported device or mismatch means no write; rollback requires same device identity.
Related_Use_Case_Relationships: Includes UC-08: device-specific I/O writes require authenticated peer identity and immediate target/policy revalidation.

Name: Inhibit and recover on unsafe runtime
Main_Flow: Independently detect stale evidence or failed heartbeat; block writes; restore captured prior values after target/ownership verification.
Alternatives_and_Failures: If checks fail, do not write; flag review and preserve Linux-native behavior.
Related_Use_Case_Relationships: Includes UC-13: watchdog triggers and recovery outcomes are written to the audit history.

Name: Append and verify audit history
Main_Flow: Append correlated event to hash-chained audit DB; verify chain and report gaps, resets or modification.
Alternatives_and_Failures: Integrity failure disables actuation pending review.

Name: Review status and outcomes (read-only)
Main_Flow: Read status, recommendations, mode, health, outcomes and audit summaries; distinguish zero from unavailable/stale/degraded/warming-up/denied.
Alternatives_and_Failures: No commands, approvals, policy/mode edits or actuator route; omit sensitive fields by default.
Related_Use_Case_Relationships: Includes UC-17 for operational status/outcome retrieval and UC-18 for the separately stored audit summary; both are read-only projections.

Name: Measure overhead and workload impact
Main_Flow: Record AIOS CPU/RSS/storage/write rate, freshness, decision latency and foreground impact; approve thresholds from target-host measurements.
Alternatives_and_Failures: Technical references are not demand evidence or measured benefit.

Name: Review least privilege and evidence status
Main_Flow: Inspect process/interface separation, actor permissions, privacy defaults, traceability, evidence labels and responsibility boundaries.
Alternatives_and_Failures: Privilege expansion, data leakage or unsupported claim blocks release/control.

Name: Read operational status and outcome projection
Trigger: UC-14 dashboard review requests operational data
Main_Flow: Query the read-only telemetry/decision projection persisted from accepted observations; return current mode, health, recommendations, action outcomes, timestamps, and explicit quality/availability states.
Alternatives_and_Failures: On unavailable, stale, degraded, or denied data, return its explicit state; never return an invented zero or expose a write/actuator path.
Related_Use_Case_Relationships: Included by UC-14. Reads the operational projection; it does not execute UC-04 persistence.

Name: Read audit summary and verification status
Trigger: UC-14 dashboard review requests audit information
Main_Flow: Query a read-only summary of the separate audit store; return recent correlated event summaries and chain-verification status without exposing a mutation path.
Alternatives_and_Failures: If verification is broken, missing, or unavailable, show an explicit integrity/degraded state and preserve actuation lockout; never modify audit records.
Related_Use_Case_Relationships: Included by UC-14. Reads audit records written and verified by UC-13; it does not execute the append behavior.
